name: mcx_contract_specs
notes: Specifications apply per contract expiry as the exchange states them; several specification versions trade side by side while old contracts run off. observed_trading_range is computed from mcx_daily.parquet for the contracts each entry governs.
Margins, daily price limits and position limits are omitted; they are set by MCXCCL circulars and change more often than the contract terms.
No symbol rename occurred for these four products between 2021-01-01 and 2026-09-15; every Bhav Copy row uses GOLD, SILVER, COPPER, CRUDEOIL.
